gloss: all the more; even more; especially

definitions.gloss: all the more; even more; still more
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something intensifies a situation or makes it even more applicable. Used when one condition makes another condition even stronger.

examples.english: On rainy days, I want to go out even less.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尚更|なおさら}⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}らなければならない→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: When you're sick, you need to get nutrition all the more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尚更|なおさら}⟦やりたく→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The more he opposes it, the more she wants to do it.

notes:
USAGE:
{尚更|なおさら} says that a fact already true becomes *more* true once some further condition is added. It needs that earlier condition to lean on — either stated in the same sentence or clear from context — so it rarely opens a conversation. It sits directly before the part of the clause it intensifies.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧B⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尚更|なおさら}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: if A, then B all the more
- {尚更|なおさら}〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: even less likely to ~
- {尚更|なおさら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧: all the more reason
- ⟦ましてや→ましてや：26861_mashiteya⟧〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{尚更|なおさら}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: let alone ~, which is more so still

WRITING NOTE:
Usually written in kana as なおさら. The kanji spelling {尚更|なおさら} is the more formal choice and is common in writing.

SIMILAR ADVERBS:
- ⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧: increasingly — describes a trend continuing, with no conditional step
- ⟦{一層|いっそう}→一層：01730_issou⟧: all the more — close in meaning but formal, and usable without a stated condition
- {尚更|なおさら} differs from both in requiring a prior fact that it builds on.
